findings.message: The canonical names a different URL, so this page asks search engines to index that URL instead. Confirm this is intended.
findings.evidence: canonical https://aquarythu.com vs page https://aquarythu.com/contact (a trailing slash difference alone is tolerated)

findings.message: The meta description is longer than 160 characters and may be truncated in results. This is a display heuristic, not a published search engine limit.
findings.evidence: 161 characters: AquaRythu is an aqua farm management software that helps shrimp farmers manage ponds, feed, water quality, sampling, expenses, harvests and digital farm records.

findings.message: Some images have no width and height attributes, which lets the layout shift while they load.
The page has fewer than 200 words of visible body text. Google has no minimum word count, so this is not a ranking rule. Check that the page fully answers what a visitor came for.
The page has no og:image, so shared links show no preview image.
findings.evidence: og:title is present, og:image is not
